tweaks.name: Show file extensions
tweaks.description: Always show .exe, .pdf, and other suffixes in File Explorer.

tweaks.name: Show hidden files
tweaks.description: Reveal hidden files and folders in File Explorer.

tweaks.name: Windows dark mode
tweaks.description: Switch apps and system chrome to dark appearance.

tweaks.name: Open Explorer to This PC
tweaks.description: Start File Explorer on This PC instead of Home.

tweaks.name: Align taskbar to the left
tweaks.description: Move the Windows 11 taskbar icons to the left edge.

tweaks.name: Hide Widgets button
tweaks.description: Remove the Widgets icon from the taskbar.

tweaks.name: End task from the taskbar
tweaks.description: Right-click a running app on the taskbar to end its task.

tweaks.name: Classic right-click menu
tweaks.description: Restore the full Windows 10-style Explorer context menu.

tweaks.name: Disable Bing in Start search
tweaks.description: Keep Start search on local apps and files instead of web results.

tweaks.name: Enable long file paths
tweaks.description: Allow paths longer than 260 characters. Needs administrator rights.

tweaks.name: High performance power plan
tweaks.description: Prefer the High performance scheme. On laptops this uses more battery.
